title: The zones' sprite preloads: res/field/actors/preloads.json
description: The lists of object codes whose sprites the field loads at a zone's field init, beside the hero's, into the 32-entry sprite material cache that every shown NPC's sprite needs an entry of (a/0/5/7, tools/data/npc_cache_data.py; docs/paperwhite2/design/npc-research.md, the limits). A zone's header names its list (res/field/zones/<zone>.json's npc_cache); a number past the last loads none. Dumped from the ROM for the Overworld Editor's sprite bar; the build still packs the ROM's own a/0/5/7, so editing this file changes nothing in game yet.
